Sego Homes

Single-family homes at Panorama

Sego Homes, a local Utah builder known for innovative design and signature rooftop living, brings its fresh approach to single-family homes in Herriman. Discover thoughtfully designed homes that blend modern style, everyday functionality, design to captivate views, and room to live more.

The homes

Homes at Panorama

Sego Homes brings its award-winning approach to architecture and original design to Herriman with a new signature collection of single-family homes. Each floor plan is thoughtfully designed to inspire a lifestyle where distinctive architecture meets everyday functionality.

From elevated ceilings and expansive windows that fill living spaces with natural light to spacious kitchens with oversized islands and walk-in pantries, every detail is designed with purpose. Inviting gathering spaces where your drawn to gather, while quiet flex spaces offer room to work, recharge, or retreat.

And true to Sego’s signature style, innovative indoor-outdoor connections and rooftop decks extend living beyond the walls. Intentional spaces designed to capture sweeping valley views from Panorama Point on Herriman’s coveted West Bench.
